title: Fix Vscode Extension Not Showing Up in IDEs
description: The semio-repo VSCode extension is not showing up in VSCode and other IDEs after devcontainer attach. The post-attach.sh script's CLI detection searches /vscode/vscode-server/ but the actual VSCode server binary is at /home/vscode/.vscode-server/. Fix the detection to include the correct path so the extension gets installed.
summary: Fixed post-attach.sh CLI detection: the VSCode remote-cli search path was wrong (/vscode/vscode-server/ vs actual /home/vscode/.vscode-server/). Added code-insiders variant path. Also improved VSIX staleness check to compare against all key source files. Manually installed the extension for the current session.
